essence: The procedure concerns five loci: mandala, pot, fire, disciple, and self.
Initiation unifies pervasion and assigns the three impurities to bodily loci.
The knot is identified with impurity arising from non-self appearance.
The verse connects reply-firmness to an external knot arrangement and assigns action to the arms and the Vishnu-maya self to the throat.
Imagination, arising thereby from downward-flowing flame-atomicity, produces manifoldness in the triad named nara, shakti, and shiva.
